 3 | Official benchmark result capture system (CLI-first). Captures immutable source-backed claims from official sources. Does **not** run evaluations or recalculate scores.
 4 | 
 5 | ## Setup
 6 | 
 7 | ```bash
 8 | cd ledger
 9 | python3 -m venv .venv

11 | pip install -e ".[dev]"
12 | cp .env.example .env

14 | 
15 | ## Quick start
16 | 
17 | ```bash
18 | benchmark-ledger init-db
19 | benchmark-ledger seed-registry

27 | ## Architecture
28 | 
29 | - Append-only ledgers (benchmarks, models, sources, snapshots, claims, validations, relationships, runs)

33 | 
34 | ## Tests

36 | ```bash
37 | pytest -q
38 | ```

1 | # AGENTS.md
 2 | 
 3 | ## Project
 4 | 
 5 | This repository is the **AI Benchmark Platform**:
 6 | 
 7 | 1. **Frontend** (`src/*`) — React SPA for model benchmark comparison (demo synthetic data + planned official mode).
 8 | 2. **Ledger** (`ledger/*`) — Python CLI that captures official benchmark results as immutable source-backed claims.
 9 | 
10 | The ledger does **not** run benchmarks and does **not** recalculate scores.
11 | 
12 | ## Core ledger rules
13 | 
14 | - Preserve raw source values exactly (`model_raw`, `benchmark_raw`, `score_raw`, …).
15 | - Do not overwrite result claims; source changes create new snapshots and new claims.
16 | - Snapshot official source content before extraction.
17 | - Every result claim needs `source_snapshot_id`, `official_source_id`, raw fields, and `evidence_location`.
18 | - Prefer official APIs and structured files before scraping.
19 | - Do not ingest articles, vendor blogs, newsletters, or social posts into the official result ledger (O0).
20 | - If model matching is uncertain: keep `model_raw`, leave `model_entity_id` null, mark `needs_review`.
21 | - Running ingestion twice on the same source snapshot must not create duplicate claims.
22 | - Do not deploy to paid cloud services or trigger paid operations.
23 | - Ledger MVP is **CLI-only** (no ledger web UI).
24 | 
25 | ## Frontend rules
26 | 
27 | - `getValue(modelId, benchmarkId)` is the only score accessor.
28 | - Use `cn(...)` for conditional classes; glass utilities from `index.css`.
29 | - Sticky columns: plain `overflow-x-auto` + sticky left; never Radix ScrollArea.
30 | - SOTA indicator is `.sota-cell` gold ring (not Star icon).
31 | - Model and Benchmark sheets are independent roots; never nest Sheet in Sheet.
32 | - Selected model colors from `modelColor(i)`.
33 | - Null scores render as no-data (—, dashed, placeholder).
34 | - `npm run build` / `npm run typecheck` must stay green.
35 | - Toast may remain on Radix per ADR-002; other primitives migrate toward Base UI.
36 | 
37 | ## Trust boundary
38 | 
39 | - Ledger stores **claims**: “source X reported score Z”.
40 | - UI rankings/averages are presentation-only and must not be stored as official claims.
41 | - Dual mode: demo synthetic vs official ledger export.
42 | 
43 | ## Development workflow
44 | 
45 | - Keep changes small and testable.
46 | - Fixture tests for every adapter.
47 | - Run ledger tests: `cd ledger && pytest -q`.
48 | - Run frontend: `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build`.
49 | - Update README/AGENTS when CLI or trust UI changes.
